_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: kappas from the exact joint distribution of the two ratings

agreement.claim: both engines report the same percent agreement, kappas and SEs (R's kappa values from irr)
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0, irr's kappa against Python's written-out formula. harness/agreement_examples.test.py recomputes the truths as a matrix product and shows percent agreement exceeds kappa in every seed and weighting adds more than 0.2 on average.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Both tolerances separate the kappas from zero. Measured by harness/agreement_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
